events.description: This documentary examines the case of one of the UK's most notorious double killings. events.description: Argentina v Switzerland (Kick-off 2.00am). Coverage of the fourth quarter-final, which takes place at Kansas City Stadium in the USA. Current World Cup holders Argentina survived an almighty scare in the last round as they came from 2-0 down to win 3-2 against Egypt. The African side had gone two goals ahead with 23 minutes remaining but three goals inside 13 minutes from Cristian Romero, Lionel Messi and Enzo Fernandez saw Argentina progress to their second successive quarter-final in this competition. Switzerland reached their first quarter-final since 1954 after they beat Colombia 4-3 on penalties after the game finished 0-0 in Vancouver. Before Tuesday's victory the European side had reached the round-of-16 at the last three World Cups, but heroics from goalkeeper Gregor Kobel ended that run and helped them reach this stage for the first time in 72 years

Current World Cup holders Argentina survived an almighty scare in the last round as they came from 2-0 down to win 3-2 against Egypt. The African side had gone two goals ahead with 23 minutes remaining but three goals inside 13 minutes from Cristian Romero, Lionel Messi and Enzo Fernandez saw Argentina progress to their second successive quarter-final in this competition. Switzerland reached their first quarter-final since 1954 after they beat Colombia 4-3 on penalties after the game finished 0-0 in Vancouver. Before Tuesday's victory the European side had reached the round-of-16 at the last three World Cups, but heroics from goalkeeper Gregor Kobel ended that run and helped them reach this stage for the first time in 72 years

event.description: Coverage of the second semi-final (Kick-off 8.00pm), which takes place at Atlanta Stadium in the USA. The corresponding stage of the tournament in Qatar four years ago resulted in two decisive scorelines, firstly with Argentina beating Croatia 3-0 on the back of stellar performances from Lionel Messi and Julian Alvarez, with Messi scoring from the spot and providing the assist for both goals in Alvarez's brace. That was followed by France triumphing 2-0 over a spirited Morocco who pushed the 2018 champions all the way in what was the first-ever semi-final appearance by an African nation. The Atlas Lions were unfortunate to suffer the loss of Nayef Aguerd and Romain Saiss to injury in the first-half, and saw Jawad El Yamiq's overhead kick tipped on to the post by France goalkeeper Hugo Lloris, and it proved to be the clinical finishing of Theo Hernandez and Randal Kolo Muani that settled the contest in the favour of Les Bleus
